latest.title: On radicals in differential invariants: global theory vs moving frames
latest.abstract: The classical technique of moving frames allows to effectively compute differential invariants of group actions. A standard observation is that the expressions of differential invariants contain radicals and more complicated algebraic functions, however the global Lie-Tresse theorem claims that for algebraic pseudogroup actions the algebra of differential invariants is generated by rational functions in jet variables. Here, we explain this apparent contradiction and illustrate it in a few well-elaborated examples. Constructively, our result gives a method to algorithmically compute global differential invariants.
latest.workSummary: 解释移动标架计算中出现根式与全局 Lie–Tresse 有理生成定理之间的表面矛盾，并给出把局部代数表达转为全局微分不变量的算法。
latest.breakthrough: 澄清局部截面选择制造根式的机制，并把概念解释转化为可实施的全局不变量算法。
latest.limitations: 主要是方法澄清和示例；算法复杂度、符号实现及对大型几何问题的可扩展性尚未量化。
latest.priorityReason: 对微分不变量计算有实用意义，但不是直接的曲率或拓扑突破。
